digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / deterministic floor lints (P6 family)
propositions: Close-gate cycles were burned when AC evidence living outside the codebase (live-store fsck, phantom-dir deletion, Gerrit-landed changes) was not tagged [operator-attested], causing the completion verifier to fail.

A deterministic lexicon-based advisory lint is needed to flag AC checklist items containing operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, drill, store-surgery, recorded-attestation) that lack [operator-attested] tags at plan time.
The lint extends p6_ac_quality as an advisory DET check without adding a new severity level, changing DET_CHECKS cardinality, or modifying criteria_routing.json.
The [operator-attested] tag matcher must be single-sourced between the plan-time lint and the completion-verifier enrichment path to guarantee agreement by construction.

The deterministic self-gate evaluation (committed before lint activation) must demonstrate precision ≥70% on a ≥50-item flagged sample, flag rate ≤5% over the frozen corpus, and both known cases (115b, 8c4f) firing on tag-stripped AC text.
The lint ships advisory and prompt-less in the packaged floor with unit tests confirming non-blocking status, agreement with workflow_ops on tagging, and known-case firing.
